title: Localization commutes with powers of an ideal
statement:
Let $A,B$ be commutative rings with identity, let $\varphi\colon A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism, and let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal. Write $IB=\langle\varphi(I)\rangle_B$ for the extended ideal. For every $n\in\mathbf N$ one has the equality of ideals of $B$

$$ (I^n)B=(IB)^n. $$

In particular, for $s\in A$ and the canonical localization homomorphism $A\to A_s$, one has $(I^n)A_s=(IA_s)^n$.
